gearbox.ponder.compressor.header: Using a compressor to process fluids
gearbox.ponder.compressor.text_1: The Compressor can process fluids into items
gearbox.ponder.compressor.text_2: It can be powered with a shaft from the side
gearbox.ponder.compressor.text_3: It must move clockwise from the right side
gearbox.ponder.compressor.text_4: Fluids can be inserted from the back
gearbox.ponder.compressor.text_6: Lastly, the output can be retrieved with a depot, belt or basin
gearbox.ponder.kiln.text_1: Kinetic Ovens process items by burning them with friction
gearbox.ponder.kiln.text_2: They can be powered from the back using shafts
gearbox.ponder.kiln.text_3: Throw or Insert items at the top
gearbox.ponder.kiln.text_4: After some time, the result can be obtained via Right-click
gearbox.ponder.kiln.text_5: The outputs can also be extracted by automation
gearbox.ponder.pumpjack.header: Using a pumpjack to gather resources
gearbox.ponder.pumpjack.text_1: The pumpjack is a multi-block resource extractor
gearbox.ponder.pumpjack.text_6: The well needs to be connected to bedrock through pipes
gearbox.ponder.pumpjack.text_7: And the crank be connected to a shaft to power the machine
gearbox.ponder.pumpjack.text_8: The results can then be extracted from the well with a pipe
gearbox.ponder.sapper.header: Using a sapper to gather resources
gearbox.ponder.sapper.text_1: Sappers are machines used to sap fluids from trees
gearbox.ponder.sapper.text_2: You can power them with cogs
gearbox.ponder.sapper.text_3: And then pull the output fluids from the back
